div.div:
What is visible (Android / web: the card overlay is above the route)
MENU: card 1 · container 1 (container mounts underneath, identical)
ROUTE: card 0 · container 1
RETURNING, sheet > 0.005: card 0 · container 1
RETURNING, sheet ≤ 0.005: card 1 · container 0 ← swap
iOS: the transparentModal is presented above the overlay, so the card always stays at opacity 1 (never animate opacity on glass/blur views).

div.div:
Touch ownership
closed: only the button hit area
open: scrim + rows; Android back / Esc close the menu
route: the overlay receives no touches and does not handle back. Otherwise (Android and web, overlay on top) the scrim would intercept taps on the close button
pressing: while a press that started on the button is down, its hit area stays active even in "open": on web, a pointer-events:none element never receives pointerup and the gesture would get stuck.
